attBesluta.text: Fantastic petrol can, much better than the plastic cans I've since replaced

Solid tank, I like that either opening can be used to pour. Nice, thick gasket between the valve and nozzle. I'll fill it with gas and try it out, but I anticipate that it'll work like a charm, much easier to use than those plastic nozzles which you have to have three hands to operate.
